Hi Jobgether team,

I'm applying for the Content Strategist / UGC Engineer role. Your focus on high-volume, creator-led distribution for consumer apps is exactly the kind of work I already do: I run Google Ads Search campaigns and chose buyer-intent keywords that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks in a self-funded test for a kids' bike brand, and I built a ~600-page site on one consistent layout. I also create and publish my own apps on Google Play, so I understand how short-form video hooks and scripts drive installs.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks I'd audit your current creator roster and creative formats, then set up a testing framework for hooks and scripts across TikTok and Reels. I'd love to talk about how I can help scale your campaigns.

Best,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

When I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand, I chose buyer-intent keywords and built two Dutch landing pages that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. That same instinct for what makes people stop and act is what I'd bring to your creator-led campaigns. Your partner company builds high-volume UGC distribution for consumer apps, and I've spent the last years doing the analytical and creative work behind that: writing hooks, testing formats, and turning performance data into repeatable playbooks.

At Episto I built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I ranked a personal-brand site #3 on Google for "Belgian chess prodigy" through technical SEO and schema markup. As a freelancer I sell AI search visibility and marketing automation, and I built my own Android app, PupSmart, from concept to launch on Google Play. That means I understand how short-form video drives installs and engagement because I've shipped products myself. I also coach and give feedback: as a tango instructor I ran a studio's daily operations and taught classes, which taught me to give clear, specific feedback that helps people improve.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks I'd audit your current creator roster and creative formats, then set up a structured testing framework for hooks and scripts across TikTok and Instagram Reels. I'd love to talk about how I can help scale your campaigns.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36

cv_text:
# Baver Ok
Short-form video · Creator coaching · Creative testing · Data-driven growth
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | [+32 470 42 48 36](tel:+32470424836) | [baverok@gmail.com](mailto:baverok@gmail.com)
[linkedin.com/in/baverok](https://www.linkedin.com/in/baverok) | [baverok.com](https://baverok.com) | 02-04-1994
English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
Digital marketer with a sales mindset who judges a website by the customers it brings in. At Episto I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building, and as a freelancer I bring in and scope my own clients. Years as a tango instructor in Türkiye taught me to work with people every day, build trust and take ownership of a whole studio, from the first class of the day to closing. My start in front-end development means I can build a landing page, run a Google Ads campaign and read the data without waiting on anyone. Outside client work I build my own products with AI, from a dog-care app on Google Play to fitness and nutrition trackers, which keeps me close to how real users find, try and stick with a product. I am analytical, I follow search engine algorithm updates closely, and I am eager to learn. I want a commercial team where that ownership turns into more customers.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### Rebound – personal fitness app
- Built a fitness app that logs every workout and syncs data from a smartwatch and smart scale, turning steps, calories and body stats into clear progress graphs
- Developed and deployed it solo with AI coding tools (Claude Code), shipping features as soon as needed

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

## SKILLS
- **Growth & sales:** A/B testing, landing pages, lead generation, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals
- **SEO & marketing:** content marketing, Google Ads Search, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), WooCommerce
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016

- [Semrush Academy – SEO Toolkit](https://static.semrush.com/academy/certificates/35c1af233e/baver-ok_25.pdf) (2026)
